method: three independent fresh 'claude -p' passes (tools Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep; no history, no repository access) over a blind packet built by scripts/auto_extract.py build_packet; the paper text is the Europe PMC full-text XML of PMC7750970 flattened to section chunks (the PDF could not be downloaded), so 'page' in the answers is the chunk number, not a PDF page
questions_derive_from: the metric lines of the round-2 run output (FP, FN, CRP a_0, number of clusters, Lugsail PSRF)
outcome: no question has two agreeing passes with a value; pass 1 found the simulation settings FP 0.1% and FN 30% (settings fixed by the authors for simulated data, not results); passes 2 and 3 answered not_found for all five; no claim candidate exists
